title: How My Geothermal Heat Pump Really Performed (2 Years)
summary: A Massachusetts homeowner reports two years of geothermal heat pump costs: high upfront price, low running cost close to projections, and maintenance similar to gas.

assertions.quote: You're essentially using one watt of electricity to move three to five watts of heat.
the projected yearly operating costs were less than half what a comparable air source system would run in my area.
But an air source heat pump at those same frigid, 20 below, air temperatures would lose
After the federal rebates, the system cost came down to about $54,000.
However, federal, state, and utility rebates can dramatically reduce those costs

verdicts.note: Mass Save example: the whole-home rebate of $8,500 covers about 39% of the $22,000 average install, and the income-based $16,000 covers about 73%; this is one generous utility program, not a national picture.

LBNL: 71% of projects got rebates, with a median of $1,327 (21% of gross cost, mean 30%); electrification programs such as MA DOER Home MVP gave higher shares (37%), so rebates covered a meaningful but usually minority share.

assertions.quote: Turns out that the cost of maintaining my geothermal system is basically the same as the natural gas HVAC system

verdicts.note: Seven homeowners needed contractor visits, mostly minor control, sensor or condensate issues fixed in one visit, and the team judged this not atypical compared with their previous systems; the units were prototypes and the sample was small.

Consumer Reports' survey of members who installed 13,753 heat pumps (2009-2025) found 29 percent broke or stopped working by the end of the eighth year, which CR says makes heat pumps one of the least reliable product categories it rates; a self-selected owner survey with the furnace comparison implied rather than shown, and the units both heat and cool.

assertions.quote: operating cost of my HVAC and hot water setup is, well, it's basically zero.
Geothermal HVAC systems are best run with little to no temperature setback

verdicts.note: Manufacturers recommend minimal setback because recovery from deep setbacks can trigger backup heat and offsets savings.

assertions.quote: This captures waste heat from the system and uses it to preheat water

verdicts.note: Desuperheaters recover compressor heat to preheat water, mainly during cooling season.
